client: Ledgerline Accounting
client_industry: accounting
start: 2021-09
end: 2021-12
engagement: fixed
stack:

metrics:

The review is from: Ledgerline Accounting
Rating: 4.5 out of 5

text: Noor got our invoice extraction service up and running on a tight fixed timeline and kept the work moving without us having to chase updates. He delivered a solid solution that handled scanned supplier invoices and gave us the fields we needed in JSON, and we saw manual data entry drop by about 70%. The final accuracy was strong at 96.2% on 1,800 test invoices, and he was responsive when we needed adjustments.
